questions.question: Which of the following public-health gaps is primarily targeted by the Diverse Epigenetic Epidemiology Partnership (DEEP)?
options: Lack of diversity in genomic research
Lack of geographical research on human health
Lack of awareness about sanitation practices
Lack of nutrition research on humans
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Lack of diversity in genomic research) है।

questions.question: In May 2025, the Chief Minister of which state laid the foundation stone for India’s first Artificial Intelligence-based Data Center Park?
Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution has a provision for the auditing of accounts of Panchayats?
Who among the following was the director of the movie Mughal-e-Azam?
Which of the following happens to money supply during inflation?
options: The value of the money increases.
The value of the money remains stable.
The value of the money decreases.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The value of the money decreases.) है।

questions.question: Which of the following sectors is most directly impacted by the adoption of Advanced Chemistry Cells (ACC)?
options: Electric mobility and renewable energy storage
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Electric mobility and renewable energy storage) है।

questions.question: Who, along with Rishabh Yadav of India, broke the mixed team world record at the 2025 Archery World Cup in Madrid?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Jyothi Surekha Vennam) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution directs the state to take steps to organise village panchayats?

Match the film industry with its associated language. 										Film Industry			Language							a. Bollywood			i. Hindi language							b. Kollywood			ii. Tamil language							c. Tollywood			iii. Telugu language							d. Mallywood			iv. Malayalam language
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (a-i; b-ii; c-iii; d-iv) है।

questions.question: The Aunta-Simaria Bridge, opened in August 2025, connects which regions in Bihar across the Ganges?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Mokama and Begusarai) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Vedas is mainly considered as the originator of music?
In which of the following Indian cities was the country's fastest and indigenously designed IP/Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) router launched in March 2024?
Depreciation adding to the net value added in the national accounting system is known as _________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (gross value added) है।

options: Indian Institute of Remote Sensing – Dehradun
Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology – Bengaluru

questions.question: In relation with the pressure and winds, India lies in the region of __________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (North easterly winds) है।
